scan_devices.description: List of block devices to scan for LDM metadata (e.g., /dev/sda). Corresponds to -d/--device option.

action.description: The primary action to execute: scan, show, create, or remove.

show_type.description: The entity type to show when action is 'show'. One of: diskgroup, volume, partition, disk.

show_diskgroup_guid.description: The GUID of the disk group to show details for.

show_object_name.description: The name of the volume, partition, or disk to show details for within the group.
